ModMetaData.name: Actual God Mode
ModMetaData.author: jafex
ModMetaData.description:
Become the god of your colony. Inspired by Black & White.
Your colonists' faith fuels your Divine Power. Answer their prayers, work miracles by drawing gestures, and decide whether you are worshipped out of love or fear.
No DLC required. Integrates with DLCs when present.
